fix(test): make reviewed special admission fixtures portable across Git packing

Only scripts/tests/inkwave-reviewed-special-delta-admission.test.mjs changes. Disable detached automatic packing only in disposable fixture repositories, and test complete packed stores plus a separate explicitly missing-object packed fixture without assuming loose-object placement.

Exact tree of private fixture repair a68c39a06ae6e83adf5308b1bb841e558ae8786f; parent is official 4c9b7861038189e709db5e80e64d2a2712f7b877. Production helper, pins, workflow, runtime and build inputs are unchanged. This narrow fixture repair does not complete the outstanding broad final admission or real-browser acceptance.
